purpose: One destination row of a Sidebar: leading icon, label, optional count, trend Badge and trailing icon; Current marks the page you are on. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Sidebar.
A command row in a floating menu.
A destination in a mobile bottom bar.
A navigation item outside the Sidebar.

Default.visual: No fill; icon and label Content/primary, trailing count Content/secondary.

Focused.visual: Fill Surface/muted with Border/focus inside and a Border/ring/default ring.

Current.meaning: The page the person is on (aria-current="page").

Disabled.visual: Icon, label and trailing in Content/disabled; no fill.

Collapsed=false.visual: The full row: icon, label, count, trend Badge and trailing icon.

Collapsed=true.visual: A square of the row height showing only the icon; the label stays in the accessible name.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it unless disabled; Enter (and Space for a button) activates it.
notes: A button, or a link with asChild; aria-current="page" on the current row.
Fill and ink change with the motion role use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the use-hover colour change stay as a short fade or become instant?
Collapsed rows want a Tooltip with their label: does the row add it, or the app?
Focus: the row uses Border/focus inside plus a ring, while DropdownMenuItem moved to one ring 1 px off (DEC-2026-11-19-001). Should the Sidebar row follow?
Disabled keeps the trailing icon in Content/secondary. Should it move to Content/disabled?
